description: Re-run of the round-1 gates after the first run's four failures were fixed from its logs: the fused-graph dummy-slot reservation was one short for a capture with no live rows (now max(buckets) slots), the fused tests built two 1.88 GB pools side by side on an 8 GB card (now 256 blocks), and the FP8 writer tests demanded bit-exact agreement with torch's fp32->fp8 cast where one E4M3 ulp of disagreement is expected (attention kernels matched exactly). 0001 is kept as the record of the first run.
